query:
SELECT 
  op.productName,
  op.color,
  COUNT(*) as qty
FROM orderProducts op
JOIN orders o ON op.orderId = o.id
WHERE o.deliveryDate BETWEEN '2026-06-06' AND '2026-06-13'
  AND op.isGift = 'no'
  AND (op.productName LIKE '%UP920%' OR op.productName LIKE '%UP911%')
GROUP BY op.productName, op.color
ORDER BY op.productName, op.color;
